1: Nabi ﷺ ke chacha Abu Lahab bin Abdul Muttalib ke dono haath toot gaye, kyunke us ke tamam aamaal akaarat gaye; woh Nabi ﷺ ko takleef pahunchata tha. Us ki tamam koshishein bekaar gayin.
2: Us ka maal aur us ki aulad us ke kis kaam aa sakte hain? Na woh us ko azaab se bacha sakte hain, na us ke liye koi rehmat la sakte hain.
3: Qayamat ke din woh bahut jald bhadakti hui aag mein daakhil hoga aur us ki garmi bardasht karega.
4: Aur us ki biwi Umm Jameel bhi us mein daakhil hogi, jo Nabi ﷺ ke raaste mein kaante daal kar unhein takleef pahunchati thi.
5: Us ki gardan mein ek rassi kas kar bandhi jayegi, jis se us ko jahannum mein ghaseeta jayega.
